name: Protagonist
source: He is a natural genius who is plagued by a split personality: the normal side is timid and caring, while the other (Alter Ego) is perverted and outgoing. While able to do many things, the Protagonist tends to end up in trouble due to his Alter Ego personality.
translation: He is a natural genius who is plagued by a split personality: the normal side is timid and caring, while the other (Alter Ego) is perverted and outgoing. While able to do many things, the Protagonist tends to end up in trouble due to his Alter Ego personality.
